singlePurpose: Capture, organize and retrieve text selected or deliberately copied by the user on web pages, plus notes they write, in a local personal library with optional user-selected synchronization.

permissions.storage: Store local preferences, clipboard consent decisions, session drafts, recovery mirrors, backup snapshots and up to 99 approved webpage copy-history entries. Data is used only for the user's own capture library.
permissions.unlimitedStorage: Support growing local snippet and highlight collections, recovery copies and local backup snapshots beyond normal extension storage limits. Users can export, restore or clear their data. No unrelated browsing or advertising cache is stored.
permissions.activeTab: Read the current webpage address when the user attaches it to a quick note or explicitly captures selected text. This supports source attribution rather than collecting a full browsing history.
permissions.sidePanel: Provide quick-note entry, the latest saved records and the optional copy-history list alongside the current webpage, without interrupting reading.
permissions.alarms: Run user-configured automatic synchronization and local backup snapshots, and maintain the existing Trash retention schedule. Automatic synchronization and backup are off until configured.
permissions.identity: Authorize access to the user's Google Drive when they choose that sync service. Chrome uses its native identity API; the web compatibility path uses browser-managed Google authorization. Only drive.file is requested. No client secret or refresh token is packaged.
permissions.contextMenus: Add a context-menu action that saves text the user has selected on the current webpage, with its source URL and title.
permissions.hosts: Run packaged content scripts on supported webpages to save explicit selections, restore the user's saved highlights and, only after affirmative consent, record native copy/cut text and its source metadata. Capture can be paused and disabled per domain. Host access also connects to the user's chosen HTTPS WebDAV server and Google Drive. No remote executable code, advertising or analytics is loaded. The extension does not maintain a full browsing-history log.

dataExplanation: Website content is the selected/copied text and user-written notes. Web history is limited to source URLs/titles/times attached to saved records, not all visited pages. User activity is limited to approved copy/cut capture and its time, not click/keystroke analytics. Authentication information is user-supplied WebDAV credentials and provider-managed Google authorization used solely for the chosen sync service. Arbitrary note content is not separately analyzed into identity, health, financial, communication or location profiles.

descriptions.en:
Save useful web passages and quick notes with their sources.

• Select text and save it with the context menu or Alt+C.
• Write quick notes in the side panel, then search, read and edit them in your library.
• Browse by day, week or month, or use the masonry overview. Organize records in custom folders.
• Optionally save webpage copy/cut history after agreeing to enable it. Keep up to 99 local entries and turn a copy into a note with one click. Pause capture anytime.
• Restore trashed records, import and export JSON backups, and keep local snapshots.
• Optionally sync records and folders through Google Drive or your HTTPS WebDAV server.
• Choose light or dark appearance and English, Simplified Chinese or Japanese.

Records stay on your device unless you enable cloud synchronization. Temporary copy history, highlights and preferences are not synchronized. The extension does not run advertising, analytics or usage tracking. Capture is unavailable on browser-protected pages.

Version 2.0.0 improves the interface, full-text reading, folders, display options, import compatibility and backup reliability.
descriptions.zh-CN:
保存网页中有用的文字，以及随时出现的想法。

• 选中文字，右键或按 Alt+C 保存摘录，并保留网页来源。
• 在侧栏写闪记，在片段库搜索、阅读全文和编辑。
• 按天、周、月分组，或使用瀑布流汇总；支持自定义文件夹。
• 确认开启后，可自动保存网页复制、剪切历史，最多保留本机最近 99 条；一键转为闪记，也可随时暂停。
• 支持回收站恢复、JSON 导入导出、本地快照和可配置的自动备份。
• 可选择 Google Drive 或 HTTPS WebDAV，同步记录和文件夹。
• 支持浅色、深色及中文、英文、日文。

数据默认保存在本机，启用同步后才传给你选择的服务。临时复制历史、高亮和偏好不参与同步。扩展不含广告和使用情况追踪。浏览器受保护页面不支持记录。

2.0.0：优化界面与操作，新增文件夹和展示切换，改进旧备份导入、同步及备份可靠性。
descriptions.ja:
役立つウェブの文章や思いつきを、出典と一緒に保存します。

• 選択した文字を右クリックや Alt+C で保存。
• サイドパネルでメモを書き、ライブラリで検索・全文表示・編集。
• 日別・週別・月別表示、一覧表示、カスタムフォルダに対応。
• 同意して有効にすると、ウェブのコピー・切り取り履歴を端末に最大99件保存。メモへの変換や一時停止もできます。
• ゴミ箱からの復元、JSONの読み込みと書き出し、ローカルスナップショット、自動バックアップに対応。
• 必要に応じて Google Drive または HTTPS WebDAV で記録とフォルダを同期。
• ライト・ダークテーマ、日本語・英語・簡体字中国語に対応。

データは初期状態では端末に保存されます。同期を有効にした場合のみ、選択したサービスへ送信されます。一時的なコピー履歴、ハイライト、設定は同期しません。拡張機能内の広告、分析、利用状況の追跡はありません。ブラウザで保護されたページでは記録できません。

2.0.0では画面と操作を改善し、フォルダと表示切り替え、旧バックアップの読み込み、同期・バックアップの信頼性を向上しました。
